_meta.title: Social Engineering & Physical Access
_meta.description: The oldest exploit and still the highest-ROI attack in existence: humans, trust, and the physical layer. Every defensive control here is a process control - technology barely helps, which is exactly why her knowledge base needs it.

techniques.name: Phishing & Spear Phishing Infrastructure
techniques.summary: Weaponized email: credential-harvest clones, macro documents, link-t0-evil-twin-portal chains. The infrastructure game (lookalike domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC pass-through via lookalikes, MFA-aware reverse proxies like Evilginx-class tooling that proxy the real login and steal the session cookie) is what separates spray-and-pray from targeted compromise.

detection.description: Lookalike-domain registrations (dnstwist-class monitoring as defense), impossible-travel logins, session-cookie replay from novel ASNs (the reverse-proxy tell), mailbox-rule creation post-login, report-button volume as the human sensor.
mitigations: Phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2/WebAuthn) - session theft dies here (proxied logins get useless)
User report-button culture with fast feedback loops
Conditional access: device compliance + location heuristics

techniques.name: Vishing, MFA Fatigue & Helpdesk Social Engineering
techniques.summary: Voice-first compromise: MFA-push spam until approval (fatigue), helpdesk password resets against a confident voice with a name and employee-adjacent details (the MGM-class pattern), SIM-swap to own SMS-based MFA. The 2023 casino breaches made this the textbook modern initial access.

detection.description: MFA push denial-rate spikes per user (denials are telemetry: report the fatigue attempt), repeated reset requests per identity, helpdesk verification failures in tickets, SIM-swap indicators (carrier alerts, sudden SMS silence followed by failed logins).
mitigations: Number matching in MFA push (kills blind-approve fatigue)
Helpdesk verification: manager + ticket + video or identity-proofing for resets - zero voice-only resets for privileged accounts
FIDO2 over push/SMS wherever possible; carrier-level SIM-swap locks
Log and alert every MFA denial

techniques.name: Pretexting & Physical Intrusion (Tailgating, Badge Cloning)
techniques.summary: Physical access is root access: tailgating behind badge holders, cloned HID-seucer credentials (the classic low-frequency 125 kHz cards clone with a $30 device), delivery-person pretexts, conference-room installs. Once inside: network drops in conference rooms, posted passwords, unattended laptops.

detection.description: Badge-in without badge-out pairs, door-forced-open alarms, anti-passback violations, camera-review flags (no visible human at badge events), unknown MACs on internal drops, physical access anomalies correlated with logical anomalies.
mitigations: Mantrap entries, security-desk badge verification, anti-passback enforcement
Upgrade to high-frequency smart credentials (SEOS-class) or mobile credentials
Network-drop 802.1X (a plugged-in cable is not access)
Clean-desk policy, screen-lock enforcement, visitor escort culture
